translate_en|mods/GrassierGrass/42/media: Let players turn the grass off
On: each player may switch Grassier Grass off in Viewpoint's settings (Graphics > Grass). Off: the grass is always drawn for everyone, so no one can turn it off to see through it, as on PvP servers.
Days for grass to grow fully
In-game days, counted from the outbreak, until lawns reach their full height; also how long mown grass takes to grow back.
On: lawns start short and grow over the days, to about twice as tall, and mown grass grows back at that pace. Off: the grass stays one height, and mown grass grows back over the days set below.
Players' density setting is raised to at least this share of their quality's. 25 is no minimum.
Players' draw distance setting is raised to at least this share of their quality's. 50 is no minimum.
Players' grass height is raised to at least this. 50 is no minimum. Stops players shortening the grass to see over it.
Players' grass quality is raised to at least this. Low lets everyone choose freely. Higher keeps the grass as thick for everyone, at a cost on weaker computers.
With a Minecraft shader pack on, players' grass density is raised to at least this share. 10 is no minimum.
Players' height variation is raised to at least this. 0 is no minimum. Stops players flattening the tall patches to see through them.
On: the far grass beyond the blades is drawn for everyone, so far fields can't be thinned out to spot players.
